test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A person bought an article and sold it at a loss of 15%. If he would have sold it for Rs. 50 more, he could have gained 10%. What was the original cost price of the article?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let x be the cost price of the article

Selling price when the article is sold at a loss of 15% = x – 15% of x = 0.85x

Selling price when the article is sold at a profit of 10% = x + 15% of x = 1.10x

According to the given information,

0.85x + 50 = 1.10x

⇒ 1.10 x – 0.85 x = 50

⇒ 0.25 x = 50

⇒ x = 200

Hence, the cost price of the article is Rs. 200.

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
